![Views](https://api.views-badge.org/badge/st-issue-16570)
[USER] which version of Streamlit are you using? This has been an issue in older versions but should be fixed in the latest version.

This report is the well-known **Cached ForwardMsg MISS** WebSocket error: the server sent a `ref_hash` for a cacheable delta, but the frontend `ForwardMsgCache` did not have that hash (`cd4746dc1df6dcfb073b12276a2c9e39`). That happens when `cached_message_hashes` in a rerun `BackMsg` is out of sync with the client cache — historically from a race where a previous run’s `scriptFinished` expired entries still referenced by a new run (fixed in PR #11302 / 1.45.1), and from Streamlit-in-Snowflake’s initial response cache serving refs to clients that never received the original payloads. The issue has no Streamlit version, repro, or environment, so it cannot be distinguished from those already-fixed cases versus a remaining desync. A maintainer already asked for the version; if this still happens on a current OSS release, a minimal repro (and whether it is OSS vs SiS) is needed.

### Related Issues

- [#11357](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/11357) — Same `Cached ForwardMsg MISS` connection dialog; main tracking issue after the 1.45.1 patch, later closed as fixed (including SiS rollout).
- [#11299](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/11299) — Original confirmed race with slider + large dataframe under network lag; closed by PR [#11302](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11302), which ignores stale `scriptFinished` cache cleanup.
- [#15816](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/15816) — Most recent identical sparse report (July 2026); closed as cannot-reproduce after no version or repro was provided.
